correctness.rationale: PASS: For first-order quantifier rank <=2 over strict order < and two unary letter predicates (no successor), the complete pointed rank-one profile is (letter, left-letter-set, right-letter-set), and a full rank-two sentence theory is the set S(w) of realized pointed profiles. The exact decomposition of S(w²) into the first/last copy and addition of (a,A,A) in all powers >=3 proves same-root stabilization at exponent three. The witness 0101 vs 010101 separates exponent two and three. The append-letter recurrence for state (used-letter-mask,left-pair-mask,right-pair-mask) has a finite complete reachable closure of 37 states (32 mixed-letter states). Independently constructing this closure, not merely enumerating bounded roots, yields exactly 30 square signatures, 16 cube signatures and the sharp minimal-root histograms: squares 2:2,3:6,4:10,5:10,6:2; cubes 2:2,3:6,4:6,5:2. A separate full-word closure has 90 mixed-letter rank-two theories. Closure and BFS shortest paths provide all-root completeness; small root enumeration is corroboration.

value.rationale: PASS: The FO rank-two theory of powers is a natural recognizable-word/finite-model-theory construction, and the exact 90→30→16 hierarchy, per-root exponent-three collapse, and sharp minimal representative lengths describe a genuine structural phenomenon with usable finite-state certificates. General ranker expressivity theory does not simply supply these numeric power-image distributions.

limitations: Mixed-letter binary words, strict linear order and first-order quantifier rank two only, without successor and with fixed letter names. State closure 37 is complete for the proved transition, not proof of arbitrary higher-rank logic properties.
